source.path: joinquant_archive/sources/2025年度精选策略/82.无需先验知识，动态选择的etf轮动策略，更具鲁棒性.py

hypothesis: A point-in-time top-volume ETF universe combined with short-term cross-sectional momentum and a persistent low-volume risk-off state may capture liquid ETF trends without a hand-selected asset pool.
lineage: original intraday source -> previous-close/next-open causal daily reconstruction

causal_execution.observation: previous completed trading day close and volume
causal_execution.universe: ETF lifecycle and B-or-better bar availability at observation date
causal_execution.position_rule: trade only when the selected target changes

public_calibration.stop_rule: Do not calculate post-publication performance if calibration fails.

known_limitations: No intraday 11:30 signal or 14:40 fill path is available locally.
Daily bars do not contain ETF premium, discount or subscription restrictions.
The source vintage lacks an immutable pre-publication hash and is grade B rather than A.
